title: telemetry.raw v1
description: Envelope for one OTLP batch on the telemetry.raw topic. Payload stays OTLP-native; the envelope adds tenancy and provenance.

tenant_id.description: Tenant slug, e.g. retail-shop | ember | khukuri

ingest_key_id.description: Identifier (not the secret) of the ingest key that authenticated this batch

payload.description: The raw OTLP protobuf batch, base64-encoded
